searchText: 👋 I'm preparing a talk about how we can strip the full execution client out of staking setups, with the help of Portal. What do I do to request that it be added to the schedule for the light client summit? <@552133098075193354> usually has connections to the conference scene and can probably point you in the right direction for how to get things on the agenda. I'm just curious how do validators check validity of execution if they're using portal? The thought experiment is: if every single validator runs on portal instead of local execution, who is checking the execution validity? Sure, the long answer to that question is the essence of the talk. To tease it (probably enough that you can fill in the gaps): Portal can't do it all alone, for example Verkle has to be deployed to mainnet Ah sure but with stateless eth then pbs should do it, regardless of portal or not
